changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.comment: Widen every column that stores an external file URI by the delta of its own re-spelling, so the canonical spelling always fits.

changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.comment: Course icons the length guard of 20260906100722 skipped: course/icons/{courseId}/{file} becomes courses/{courseId}/icons/{file}.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE course SET course_icon = CONCAT('courses/', SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(course_icon FROM 14) FROM 1 FOR POSITION('/' IN SUBSTRING(course_icon FROM 14)) - 1), '/icons/', SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(course_icon FROM 14) FROM POSITION('/' IN SUBSTRING(course_icon FROM 14)) + 1)) WHERE course_icon LIKE 'course/icons/%/%' AND course_icon NOT LIKE 'course/icons/%/%/%';
changeSet.rollback: UPDATE course SET course_icon = CONCAT('course/icons/', SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(course_icon FROM 9) FROM 1 FOR POSITION('/' IN SUBSTRING(course_icon FROM 9)) - 1), '/', SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(course_icon FROM 9) FROM POSITION('/' IN SUBSTRING(course_icon FROM 9)) + 7)) WHERE course_icon LIKE 'courses/%/icons/%' AND course_icon NOT LIKE 'courses/%/icons/%/%';

changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.comment: Re-spell the attachment short links inside post and answer post markdown to the canonical spelling.
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE post SET content = REGEXP_REPLACE( REGEXP_REPLACE(content, '(\\[attachment\\][^()]*\\()lecture/', '$1lectures/'), '(\\[(lecture-unit|slide)\\][^()]*\\()attachment-unit/', '$1attachment-video-units/') WHERE content REGEXP '\\[attachment\\][^()]*\\(lecture/|\\[(lecture-unit|slide)\\][^()]*\\(attachment-unit/' AND CHAR_LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE( REGEXP_REPLACE(content, '(\\[attachment\\][^()]*\\()lecture/', '$1lectures/'), '(\\[(lecture-unit|slide)\\][^()]*\\()attachment-unit/', '$1attachment-video-units/')) <= 5000;
UPDATE answer_post SET content = REGEXP_REPLACE( REGEXP_REPLACE(content, '(\\[attachment\\][^()]*\\()lecture/', '$1lectures/'), '(\\[(lecture-unit|slide)\\][^()]*\\()attachment-unit/', '$1attachment-video-units/') WHERE content REGEXP '\\[attachment\\][^()]*\\(lecture/|\\[(lecture-unit|slide)\\][^()]*\\(attachment-unit/' AND CHAR_LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE( REGEXP_REPLACE(content, '(\\[attachment\\][^()]*\\()lecture/', '$1lectures/'), '(\\[(lecture-unit|slide)\\][^()]*\\()attachment-unit/', '$1attachment-video-units/')) <= 5000;
changeSet.rollback:
UPDATE post SET content = REGEXP_REPLACE( REGEXP_REPLACE(content, '(\\[attachment\\][^()]*\\()lectures/', '$1lecture/'), '(\\[(lecture-unit|slide)\\][^()]*\\()attachment-video-units/', '$1attachment-unit/') WHERE content REGEXP '\\[attachment\\][^()]*\\(lectures/|\\[(lecture-unit|slide)\\][^()]*\\(attachment-video-units/';
UPDATE answer_post SET content = REGEXP_REPLACE( REGEXP_REPLACE(content, '(\\[attachment\\][^()]*\\()lectures/', '$1lecture/'), '(\\[(lecture-unit|slide)\\][^()]*\\()attachment-video-units/', '$1attachment-unit/') WHERE content REGEXP '\\[attachment\\][^()]*\\(lectures/|\\[(lecture-unit|slide)\\][^()]*\\(attachment-video-units/';
